# Source cost and lifetime ledger — unmeasured

All amounts use existing separately rounded `memtable.COWAllocationCharge`; every new live owner uses the original `c.maintenance`. Existing COW limits validate MaxResources in 1..2^20 and MaxInFlightBytes in the finite signed-64 range. The bounded decoder additionally rejects raw/input/window above MaxUint32 and unsupported word sizes. Existing trusted snapshot allocation descriptors and their unchanged enrollment helper retain their original bounds. No capacity sufficiency or measured escape/alloc claim is made before hosted compiler/source-bound qualification.

| Original containing owner / new allocation | Admission and finite bound | Release edge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Original backend basis capture | Original `cowBasisCharge`, plus separately rounded six pointer words for fixed caller/unwind cells. Existing snapshot/pin/metadata retention rules unchanged. This source accounting change also affects other basis captures and requires fresh cost qualification. | Original basis's actual Snapshot finalizer/completion and original cleanup custody; selected caller clears basis slot before unwind cleanup. |
| Private next cut | Original `cowCutCharge` plus separately rounded six pointer words for fixed unwind cells, before allocation. Covered handoff logic unchanged. | Original private-cut cancellation or eventual original published-cut release. No private cancellation after a successful returned publication. |
| Per-operation maintenance scope | `sizeof(cowMaintenanceLeafScope)` + MaxResources*`sizeof(cowMaintenanceDictionaryEntry)` + 16 pointer words for fixed callback/caller cells, all rounded separately and admitted before allocation/gate. Existing validated MaxResources keeps multiplication finite; explicit multiplication guard remains. | Empty/no-effect scope: clear all aliases and original cleanup record then independent accounting. With effects: transfer same original record after gate, clear scope aliases only after successful destruction, worker clears record/work then completes independent scope lease. Failed scope/record/lease retained. |
| Distinct dictionary owner | Existing authenticated kernel admits `sizeof(DictionaryReadDefinition)` and callback cells before creating owner; exact early Into slot owns it before subsequent callbacks. Fixed entry vector caps count. Repeated IDs do not create another owner. | Off-gate checked original capture completion; bytes and physical pin retired by same owner. Failed owner/receipts stay on same original cleanup record. |
| Definition capture / metadata / pin / bytes | Existing maintenance `admitCOWSnapshotRetention` with original snapshot descriptors and metadata pair. Owner/callback/definition/payload/pin fields rounded separately; callback three words added. MapHint/FileCount may not exceed original MaxResources. No ordinary budget or current logical replacement capture used. | Original Snapshot callback proves completed original capture; snapshot aliases/metadata and release callback fields detached before refund. Definition/pin/bytes remain until this synchronous reader is finished and worker cleanup runs. A missing or failed completion refuses refund. |
| Bounded dictionary decoder / raw/input | Existing `COWBoundedDecoderRetentionSizes` wrapper, raw, input + three pointer words; admitted before construction. Same typed COWExternalLease passed to `NewCOWBoundedDecoder`, so actual library retention grows/refunds through original `ResizeWork`; no generic 16MiB envelope or global decoder. | Synchronous call defer closes decoder, clears method/raw/input aliases, then closes its lease. Partial definition survives in scope independently. Existing decoder closes failed construction before returning its error. |
| Native refresh scratch / borrowed scope | Existing scratch admission uses actual sizeof enlarged scratch plus original callback cells. No reader/provider retained by nativeEngineVersion. | Original scratch defer zeros entire containing scratch and scope borrow before original scratch receipt closes. |
| Cleanup failure records | Existing preborn scope record and original per-entry owners; first cleanup error retained directly, other failed owners retain their own exact failure. No new per-entry error aggregation allocation in scope. | Existing worker failure parking, original poison/error/checked Close; no retry or terminal refund on failure. |

The fixed pointer-word envelopes are explicit source reservations for bounded callback/unwind cells, not measured compiler-escape results. Pinned compile/source review must reject any concrete retained allocation omitted from this ledger. Source tests assert unchanged ordinary-budget bytes/leases, exact maintenance restoration on successful/error/unwind paths, and retained same-record charge on incomplete cleanup. They have not run. Changing these charge operands or the shared definition wrapper changes executable and costs; original performance approvals cannot carry forward.

Writer/publication order, before/after root/LSN checks and logical source ownership stay unchanged. The scope entry table and dictionary byte copies can legitimately exhaust original capacity for many distinct dictionaries; refusal/poison remains real. Successful 256-document/default-policy/recovery validation and source-bound allocation/performance qualification are required before claiming supported-workload sufficiency.
